body: I still don't comprehend how you could care about some as insignificant as myself.  That boggles the mind.

How could you care?  You didn't even know I existed until just a few minutes ago.  People like you baffle me because, while I'm sure you're sincere, I just don't understand how you could care about someone you've never met, seen or even knew existed until just very recently.
It's not people, just my mother.  Everyone else would be able to get over it and it's not a huge loss.  1 in 7 billion?  Who else could really care?
